title: Zealous Savory Russian Beef Dumplings
description: Savory Russian dumplings filled with beef and cheese, steamed to perfection in leaf wraps, featuring a hint of unsweetened cocoa for a unique flavor experience, perfect for a date night
instructions: Combine ground beef, unsweetened cocoa powder, farmers cheese, onion, garlic, egg, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl and mix until just combined.
Gradually add the flour to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a tablespoon of the beef mixture in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil and reduce the heat to a simmer.
Place a steamer basket over the pot and add the dumplings to the basket, leaving space between each dumpling.
Cover the pot with a lid and steam the dumplings for 15 minutes.
Wrap each dumpling in a napa cabbage leaf and serve hot.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
